redirects.comment: Hot Wheels was split across two brands until 2026-09-07; a product can only hold one brand, so premium and mainline merged onto /brand/hotwheels. This URL was indexed since Aug 5 — a 301 passes that ranking to the surviving page instead of stranding it (brand slugs are immutable, so it cannot be renamed).

Retired the same day as the brand merge: both listed Hot Wheels cars that now live on /brand/hotwheels. 301'd rather than left to 404 because either may already be indexed — a redirect passes any ranking on instead of stranding it.

Google indexed this filtered view on 2026-09-02, and the merge left it querying a brand that no longer exists — it would render an empty grid. Its canonical already points at /brand/hot-wheels-premium, which 301s onward, but redirecting the query form directly avoids showing anyone an empty shop on the way.
